items.title: If the AI bubble bursts, how badly could Ireland be hit?
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is fuelling a stock market boom unlike anything seen before, with tech giants spending trillions in a race to dominate AI. But what if the hype doesn’t live up to the promise? Kevin Doyle is joined by Irish Independent columnist Richard Curran to ask whether we’re watching the next financial bubble inflate, and what an AI crash could mean for Ireland’s jobs, economy and future.The Indo Daily is part of the Trust Project.
